name: Koh Talabeng & Koh Bubu

seo.title: Koh Talabeng Kayak & Koh Bubu | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Kayak into the sea cave of Koh Talabeng from Koh Lanta, then lunch on Koh Bubu. Half day from 1,000 THB, full day from 1,300 THB, hotel transfer included.

h1: Koh Talabeng and Koh Bubu by kayak and longtail
lead: The sea cave of Koh Talabeng by kayak, from Thung Yee Peng pier: a half day with the mangrove, or a full day with lunch on Koh Bubu or a stop at Koh Phee.
promise: Paddle round Koh Talabeng, then the beach on Koh Bubu

facts.label: Start
facts.value: Thung Yee Peng pier, east coast

facts.label: Where
facts.value: East coast of Koh Lanta: Koh Talabeng, Koh Bubu

facts.label: Village entrance fee
facts.value: 40 THB per adult, 20 THB per child from 4 to 11, not included

options.label: Sea cave kayaking and island hopping, 1 day
Sea cave kayaking and mangrove, half day

steps.label: 1 day
steps.text: Sea cave kayaking and island hopping. Mangrove and monkeys, Koh Aung, then Koh Talabeng by longtail with kayaking and the sea cave. Lunch and a swim on Koh Bubu. 09:00 to 15:00.

steps.label: 1 day
steps.text: Love kayak, two places. Paddling in the mangrove, then Koh Talabeng by longtail, the sea cave by kayak, a look at Skull Island, lunch on the beach and Koh Phee by longtail. 09:00 to 15:30.

steps.label: Half day
steps.text: Sea cave kayaking and mangrove. Mangrove forest, longtail to Koh Talabeng and Koh Ung, the sea cave by kayak and the monkey point. 09:30 to 12:30 or 14:00 to 17:00.

beforeYouBook.pickup: Pickup at your hotel, then Thung Yee Peng pier on the east coast.
beforeYouBook.health: Tell us if you have never kayaked.
beforeYouBook.children: Children from 4 to 11 have their own rate.

faq.q: Which trip goes to Koh Bubu?
faq.a: The full day with island hopping: Koh Talabeng and its sea cave by kayak, then lunch and a swim on Koh Bubu, from 09:00 to 15:00.
Yes. The mangrove, Koh Talabeng and its sea cave by kayak, Koh Ung and the monkey point, from 09:30 to 12:30 or from 14:00 to 17:00.
No. Tell us if it is your first time.

legacyText.title: Koh Talabeng Kayak & Koh Bubu | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: Koh Talabeng is a group of limestone islets off the east coast of Koh Lanta. You paddle around them by kayak. Koh Bubu is a small island nearby, reached by longtail, with a beach for the stop.
legacyText.cardDescription: Kayaking around the limestone islets of Koh Talabeng, then a beach stop on Koh Bubu.
goodToKnow: Tell us if you have never kayaked. The kayaks are two-seaters.
Give us the ages of children when you book. Full-day and half-day kayak trips to Koh Talabeng, with prices, are on the kayaking page.
